title: centratherum repens
intro: Centratherum repens, commonly known as Black Needle Grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, due to its health benefits of reducing swelling and pain. The therapeutic actions of Centratherum repens include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and health benefits.
